# [TASK] Accented/dialectal English+German test-recording fixture

## Task
Build a small accented/dialectal test-recording fixture for English and
German and add it as a regression check.

## Scope
Test fixture and the regression test that uses it — not the models or
parser themselves.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] At least 6 English and 4 German short recordings covering non-native and/or regional pronunciation, committed as test resources (`ls backend/ai-service/src/test/resources/accent-fixtures/{en,de}/*.wav`)
- [ ] A test asserts each recording transcribes to the expected command via the full pipeline (STT + intent parsing) — STT half only so far (`AccentedSpeechFixtureTest`); see Notes
- [x] Fixture and test documented so future accent/dialect samples can be added the same way (`backend/ai-service/src/test/resources/accent-fixtures/README.md`, `infrastructure/scripts/generate-accent-fixtures.sh`)
- [x] No real personal audio identifying anyone outside the project is committed (all 10 fixtures are synthetic espeak-ng/mbrola TTS, not recordings of a person)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 5

## Notes
Recordings are synthetic (espeak-ng/mbrola TTS through regional/non-native voices where available — Scottish, Lancaster, West Midlands and Caribbean English, Romanian- and German-accented English, German-Bavarian dialect — plus acoustic-diversity-only German speaker profiles where no dialectal voice exists offline), not real human recordings: this environment has no microphone or consenting speaker. `manifest.json`'s `accentLabel` states which category each file is; a human with real recordings can add them the same way (see the README).

AC2 rescoped to STT-only: `AccentedSpeechFixtureTest` transcribes every fixture through the real `SpeechToTextService` and asserts the recognized text, the part `AiServiceIntegrationTest`'s full-pipeline tests and ADR-021 left unverified. It does not chain through the real, Ollama-backed `VoiceCommandParsingService` — that needs a live Ollama on top of Vosk, retesting chaining/phrasing-tolerance `AiServiceIntegrationTest` and `VoiceCommandParsingServiceTest` already cover with a mocked model. `manifest.json` carries `expectedCommand`/`expectedMode`/`expectedGenre` per fixture for whoever extends this with a live Ollama later.

Like #229 and #238, this has never run against real Vosk models in any sandbox: no network egress to alphacephei.com to run `download-vosk-model.sh` (#229). The 2 new tests skip via `Assumptions.assumeTrue` when the models are absent, rather than silently pass. Leaving AC2 unchecked until a run with real network egress confirms the actual transcripts.
